from PIL import Image
import numpy as np
im=np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
# detect horizontal/vertical edge strength in crops to locate object boundaries; output peaks
import cv2
for name,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in [('ball',(1000,100,1600,650)),('block',(2900,100,3500,900))]:
 a=im[y0:y1,x0:x1]

 ex=np.abs(gx).mean(0);ey=np.abs(gy).mean(1)
 print('\\n',name,'x peaks',[(int(x0+i),round(float(ex[i]),1)) for i in np.argsort(ex)[-20:][::-1]])
 print(name,'y peaks',[(int(y0+i),round(float(ey[i]),1)) for i in np.argsort(ey)[-20:][::-1]])
